source_text: A key outcome was the adoption of the "Declaration of the First International Symposium on Circumcision" by the general assembly, which condemned non-therapeutic circumcision as a violation of the United Nations Universal Declaration of Human Rights, particularly Article V prohibiting cruel treatment, and invoked the Hippocratic principle of "first, do no harm" to advocate for its cessation. [21]
